newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 73.2 bln marks in tender at 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 73.2 bln marks in tender at 3 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it had allocated 73.2 billion marks in securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed rate of three percent, the rate that has prevailed since late August.

A repo pact for 72.7 billion marks at a fixed three percent percent expires today, Wednesday. Additionally 3.2 billion marks, injected by the Bundesbank on Friday for a short five-day period also expire today. So a net 2.7 billion marks is draining from the market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 242 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week. It accepted 30.25 percent of the bids.
